Instructions for Use
Device description: The Vega Fixation System is a orthopedic screw system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Vega Fixation System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at ≤ 3 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 20 T/m.
- Gradient slew rate limited to 100 T/m/s per axis.
- Integrated Whole Body Transmit Coil.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
- B1+RMS of 1.5 μT or less.
- WB-SAR ≤ 0.5 W/kg.
- Scan for up to 20 minutes.
